rationale: First-ever iteration of xgb_regime_blend (0 prior in DB across both modes). Defaults yielded 0/7 wp but with notable W2 +10.0% ann/42.9% WR (only 1pp short of 44% regime bar) and W1 +3.0% ann/41.7% WR. Low avg DD (9.8%) shows the regime routing is conservative, not blowing up — exactly the inductive bias the W5 wall needs. The 16-HP search space (bear_quantile, temperature, regime_feature_idx in {15,16,19,12}, magnitude_scale, base_weight, pos_class_weight + standard XGB quadrant) is structurally untouched and orthogonal to any prior sweep. W7 collapse to 17 trades suggests pos_class_weight needs to drop and/or temperature should soften — both are in the sweep space.
